limits: The ledger retains at most 1024 terminal events and 512 characters per name; truncation cannot produce complete acceptance.
The 4 MiB selected-file bound has exact-limit and one-byte-over controls; all files are preflighted before any test runs.
Node test timeouts are not universal hard process deadlines or descendant-cleanup evidence.
Repeated source and installed profile counts are separate runs of the same assertions, not independent detection coverage.
Optional skips in the full suite remain unavailable coverage.
Raw-output archives, full source/tool/dependency/environment identities, external model attempts, host independence and wider Gate A work remain required.
